players.bio: Alexander Michael Bass (born 1 April 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Peterborough United.
Bastian Smith is a 20-year-old English professional football goalkeeper who plays for Peterborough United F.C.
Ben Woods (born 27 September 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Peterborough United.
Boluwatife Samuel Shofowoke is an English born Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Peterborough United.

Brandon Singh Khela (born 19 January 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One side Peterborough United. Khela came through the academy of Birmingham City and in 2022 became the first British South Asian to sign a professional contract with that club.

Carl Robert Johnston (born 29 May 2002) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a Right-back for EFL League One side Peterborough United. After spending seven years with the academy of Linfield, Johnston joined Fleetwood Town's academy in 2018. In January 2020, Johnston signed his first professional contract with Fleetwood Town.

Christopher Seamus Michael Conn-Clarke is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One side Peterborough United. Having started his senior career at Glentoran, Conn-Clarke joined Premier League club Burnley as a scholar in 2018. Having started his senior career at Glentoran, Conn-Clarke joined Premier League club Burnley as a scholar in 2018.
Collin Christin Andeng-Ndi (born 1 August 2003) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a Goalkeeper for EFL League One club Peterborough United.
Daniel Lee Ormerod (born 19 April 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Peterborough United.
David Chukwudubem Okagbue (born 4 February 2004) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for League One club Peterborough United. He is a Republic of Ireland youth international.

Declan Frith (born 16 May 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One side Peterborough United. He began his career at Welling United before spending time in the academies of both Aston Villa and Chelsea, appearing for both their U21 sides in the EFL Trophy.
Donay Kaylin O'Brien-Brady (born 15 January 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Peterborough United.
Ethan Demai Williams is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Peterborough United.
Evan Robert Weir (born 16 April 2002) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Peterborough United.
Harley Mills is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Peterborough United.
Harrison Jones (English footballer): Born on 25 December 2004, he is a 21-year-old English professional footballer. He plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Peterborough United F.C.,
Harry Ashfield (born 23 March 2006) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Peterborough United.

Harry Paul Leonard is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Peterborough United. Leonard is a marksman with an impressive eye for goal, with intricate movement and hold-up play. He is excellent at holding possession and playing with his back towards the goal. He does a lot of unselfish work and is technically efficient.

James Daniel Dornelly (born 14 April 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Peterborough United. Dornelly joined the Peterborough United Academy in 2013 and progressed through the age groups despite missing the entirety of the 2020–21 season with injury.

Joshua Philip Feeney is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One side Peterborough United on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa. He is an England youth international.

Liam Anthony Kelly (born 22 November 1995) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One side Peterborough United. He has represented the Republic of Ireland internationally at youth levels U19 and U21.
Lucca Aboim Poyart de Mendonça is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Peterborough United.

Matthew Jimmy David Garbett (born 13 April 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a Midfielder for EFL League One side Peterborough United. Born in England, he plays for the New Zealand national team.
Owura Nsiah Edwards (born 10 April 2001) is an English footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Peterborough United.

Rio Adesola Frederick Adebisi (born 27 September 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One side Peterborough United. He joined Crewe Alexandra's Academy aged 12, progressing through the ranks to play under-23 games in 2018-19; he also went on loan to Leek Town.

Robbie Savage is a Welsh professional football manager, prominent media pundit, and former player who currently serves as the first-team manager of EFL League One club Peterborough United. During his career he played predominantly as a midfielder, starting off as a youth player with Manchester United before joining Crewe Alexandra when released by the Old Trafford club.
Samuel Joseph Hughes (born 15 April 1997) is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One side Peterborough United.

Thomas James O'Connor (born 21 April 1999) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender and midfielder for EFL League One club Peterborough United. Club career Born in Kilkenny, O'Connor first joined the Southampton academy in 2015. He was contracted to the club until June 2021 having signed a two-year contract extension in January 2019.

Todd Arthur Lucien Kane (born 17 September 1993) is an English former professional footballer who played primarily as a right back. Kane is currently an academy coach at EFL League One side Peterborough United.

Vernon Masara is a 19-year-old professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for the League One club Peterborough United F.C.. Born in England with Zimbabwean heritage, he completed a permanent move to Peterborough from Burnley in August 2026 for an undisclosed fee.
